name: youtube-clip-studio-pro
description: YouTube Clip Studio Pro - Portable Windows Desktop Video Cutter & Clip Studio
author: vanhkhuc.dev

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install
scripts.build:client: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:all: npm run build:server && npm run build:client && npm run build:electron && npm run build:icons
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npm run build:electron && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3000 electron ."
scripts.release:win: npm run build:all && electron-builder --win nsis portable
scripts.publish:win: npm run build:all && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish always
